Lower correctness verdict: `approve`. Core-fit verdict: approve. I could not break the format-control repair at `5a9f044f84fbcc21597f7bf44466cab9b3694b42`; no new human decision is needed.

Reviewer: `final_correctness`, independent of claimant `codex`. This is a bounded revalidation of the mechanical delta from `e126316ce6fa724b19353501a817ab89a6f08af3` to `5a9f044f84fbcc21597f7bf44466cab9b3694b42`, using `/private/tmp/agentfold-final-review-lower-r2`. The [earlier report](/private/tmp/agentfold-final-correctness.md) remains unchanged. This report makes no new upper-layer verdict.

The source-byte guard previously depended on the interpreter's Unicode categories. Its new pinned table now freezes the same 170 Unicode 16 format controls on Python 3.9 and 3.14. I independently enumerated Python 3.14's Unicode 16 database and found an exact set match with the table, with neither missing nor extra codepoints. The table does not change the older prose-normalization helper or the existing non-format ranges. The implementation delta is confined to [markdown_semantics.py:101](/private/tmp/agentfold-final-review-lower-r2/automation/markdown_semantics.py:101) and its Boolean predicate at [line 487](/private/tmp/agentfold-final-review-lower-r2/automation/markdown_semantics.py:487).

Independent probes exercise raw and decimal-encoded U+0891 and U+1343A in real staged retry edits and mutable human-item fields. Both manual and generated retries freeze the edits. Entity checks continue to distinguish active entities, escaped literal spellings, code spans, and even backslash runs. Six neighboring/visible characters, including U+0892, U+13440, and fullwidth A, remain editable.

| Command group actually run | Result | Skips |
|---|---|---|
| New revision, independent probes, Python 3.14.6 | 6/6 methods passed | 0 |
| New revision, independent probes, Python 3.9.6 | 6/6 methods passed | 0 |
| New revision, two newly added repository regressions, Python 3.14.6 | 2/2 methods passed | 0 |
| New revision, two newly added repository regressions, Python 3.9.6 | 2/2 methods passed | 0 |
| Prior revision, same independent probes, Python 3.9.6 | 6/6 methods executed; 22 failures, 0 errors | 0 |

The negative control produced 21 behavioral assertion failures plus one assertion that the new table was absent. It missed nine Unicode 16 format controls: U+0890, U+0891, and U+13439–U+1343F. Its visible-neighbor control passed. The same raw/encoded edits admitted by that baseline are rejected by the new revision. The table assertion is supplementary; the behavioral failures establish the negative control independently.

Probe implementation and full output:

- [Independent probe script](/private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-probes.py).
- [Independent Unicode 16 enumeration](/private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-unicode16.json), generated from the local standard library rather than from the implementation's ranges.
- [Python 3.14 probe log](/private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-probes-py314.log) and [Python 3.9 probe log](/private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-probes-py39.log).
- [Python 3.9 baseline failures](/private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-negative-py39.log).
- [Python 3.14 repository regressions](/private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-regressions-py314.log) and [Python 3.9 repository regressions](/private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-regressions-py39.log).

Commands ran from `/private/tmp/final-correctness-run` on Darwin arm64. `python3` reported Python 3.14.6 with Unicode 16.0.0; `/usr/bin/python3` reported Python 3.9.6 with Unicode 13.0.0. The clones remained read-only, imports disabled bytecode writes, and fixture files were confined to the existing scratch directory.

```sh
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=/private/tmp/final-correctness-run /usr/bin/python3 /private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-probes.py /private/tmp/agentfold-final-review-lower probes > /private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-negative-py39.log 2>&1
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=/private/tmp/final-correctness-run python3 /private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-probes.py /private/tmp/agentfold-final-review-lower-r2 regressions > /private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-regressions-py314.log 2>&1
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=/private/tmp/final-correctness-run /usr/bin/python3 /private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-probes.py /private/tmp/agentfold-final-review-lower-r2 regressions > /private/tmp/final-correctness-lower-r2-regressions-py39.log 2>&1
```

`git rev-parse HEAD` returned the reviewed revision. Final `git status --porcelain=v1` was empty in the new clone.

Core-fit: approve. Stable classification of repository source bytes applies across agent runtimes, external providers, and unrelated adopted repositories. The repair remains standard-library-only, adds no personal setup, and makes no user-global writes.

Limits: this is scoped delta evidence, not a rerun of the full lower repository suite or history admission. The parent owns the full Python matrix, exact publication candidate checks, CI, and PR operations. The finite Unicode 16 table deliberately requires a future data update for later assignments; its current membership was checked exactly against the local Unicode 16 database, not fetched from the website. No canonical queue item was created; closing records remain the parent's responsibility.
